resources.string: No voices yet. Add one below: record it or pick an audio file.
Read this aloud, then tap Stop recording:
Every morning I grab a coffee from the place down the road, check the weather, and then I take the dog for a walk around the park before work.
What you\'ll say, or what\'s said in the file
Type anything you like and read it exactly as written. For a file, type exactly what\'s said in it. This is what lets the voice keep its accent.
G\'day! This is my voice, cloned and spoken entirely on this phone. No internet needed.
More threads isn\'t faster: 4 is fastest on most phones.
Applies to voices you add from now on. Longer clips match accent and pacing better, but every sentence takes about 0.5 s longer per extra second of clip. Recording stops at this length.
